checkpoints.title: Bind audit receipts to the executing validator

debug.reproduce: Put a harmless file at the validator’s relative path in an adopter tree, then repeat with that path missing.
debug.acceptance: Both receipts identify the installed validator and revision or digest. They record adopter Git blobs separately.

checkpoints.title: Hash the learning registry snapshot used for recommendations

debug.reproduce: Simulate retiring a technique between reading the active registry and writing the receipt.
debug.acceptance: The recorded hash belongs to the snapshot that governed the decision, or intake stops explicitly. Unchanged active and retired controls behave correctly.

checkpoints.title: Use homepage precedence for repository-root fragments

debug.reproduce: Compete .github, root and docs README headings with a directory README control.
debug.acceptance: Root links resolve against the effective homepage and reject fallback-only anchors. Subdirectory links still resolve against their own README.

checkpoints.title: Handle malformed registry structure as a normal CLI failure

debug.reproduce: Use valid JSON arrays, null and invalid nested records, plus a valid registry.
debug.acceptance: Failures return a normal diagnostic and a parseable failed receipt when requested. The valid registry still passes.

checkpoints.title: Report the actual line of each broken link

debug.reproduce: Place two broken links on distinct lines of one paragraph, including repeated labels.
debug.acceptance: Diagnostics identify both exact occurrence lines. Single-line and valid-link controls retain their behavior.

checkpoints.title: Handle Graphify references that resolve to one edge

debug.reproduce: Use implicit and explicit references that resolve to the same source line. Include separate lines and relations.
debug.acceptance: Duplicates are rejected clearly or represented consistently as one resolved edge. Distinct edges survive export and MCP readback.

checkpoints.title: Run smoke checks in the selected package context

debug.reproduce: Use a package-only command and a similarly named root decoy, then repeat with an ordinary root project.
debug.acceptance: The package action executes in the declared context, the receipt identifies the working directory, and the root decoy cannot satisfy the package check.

checkpoints.title: Keep smoke output streams distinct

debug.reproduce: Split the expected marker across stdout and stderr, then emit the full marker on each intended stream in controls.
debug.acceptance: A cross-stream match fails. Valid per-stream checks pass and the observation identifies the stream used.

checkpoints.title: Bind each repair-plan partition to its approved source inventory

debug.reproduce: Remove or add source files and regenerate a self-consistent graph and receipt.
debug.acceptance: Verification catches both mutations with the expected inventory held fixed. The canonical graph and exact edges pass MCP readback.

checkpoints.title: Resolve contradictory learning decisions for one observation

debug.reproduce: Submit adopt and decline for one technique, target and source in the same request.
debug.acceptance: Intake rejects or explicitly represents the conflict. A single decision and genuinely distinct evidence remain usable.

checkpoints.title: Distinguish Git LFS pointers from corrupt media

debug.reproduce: Use a valid pointer with and without a locally available verified object, plus a malformed pointer and a normal PNG.
debug.acceptance: The checker distinguishes verified media, unavailable-object coverage and corruption. It respects the caller’s fetch policy.

checkpoints.title: Account for rendered bare GFM URLs

debug.reproduce: Use bare HTTPS and www routes, punctuation boundaries, and the same examples within code spans and fences.
debug.acceptance: Live autolinks appear in the audit or explicit coverage gaps. Literal examples remain outside link counts.

checkpoints.title: Resolve the publication root deterministically

debug.reproduce: Run on the same fixture using its root, a child directory as --repo, and a deliberate --subproject.
debug.acceptance: A child checkout path resolves to the actual root or produces a clear diagnostic. Explicit subproject selection behaves as documented.

checkpoints.title: Document how CLI evidence becomes a reviewed technique receipt

debug.reproduce: Follow the guide using a public run receipt, then try a raw or incomplete input.
debug.acceptance: A reviewer can produce a valid record tied to the exact source, case and outcome. Raw or incomplete input cannot qualify as verified. Record attempt metadata manually until .103 lands.

checkpoints.title: Check explicitly expected HTTP error bodies

debug.reproduce: Use matching and mismatching expected 404 bodies, plus success and gated-auth controls.
debug.acceptance: Matches follow the documented bounded-body policy, or an unsupported specification fails before the probe. Authentication gating remains explicit.

checkpoints.title: Resolve published GitHub refs with published semantics

debug.reproduce: Use a local-only origin/main alias, a real published slash branch, and a public HEAD link while on a local topic branch.
debug.acceptance: The alias cannot falsely verify, genuine fetched branches resolve, and HEAD uses the remote default. Retain .72’s fetched-ref controls.

checkpoints.title: Verify the repair plan’s acceptance text

debug.reproduce: Remove an acceptance section, change one obligation, and compare with the approved or explicitly revised version.
debug.acceptance: Unapproved drift fails while the approved text passes. Pin the selected plan revision and run Graphify MCP checks.

checkpoints.title: Check animation frames or report partial media coverage

debug.reproduce: Use a GIF with a truncated later frame, a valid animation and a static control.
debug.acceptance: Later-frame failure is detected or reported as partial coverage. Valid media follows the supported resource policy.

checkpoints.title: Record and verify the final destination of remote smoke requests

debug.reproduce: Compare an expected redirect, an unexpected landing page with matching text, and a direct response.
debug.acceptance: The receipt identifies the effective URL. When a destination is asserted, an unrelated landing page fails.

checkpoints.title: Report unknown technique IDs explicitly

debug.reproduce: Run unknown, active, retired and out-of-scope technique fixtures.
debug.acceptance: The unknown ID reports a diagnostic. Active IDs produce valid output and intentional exclusions are distinguishable.

checkpoints.title: Bind Graphify PR verification to the base ref and SHA

debug.reproduce: Retarget the PR between reads with the same head, then run a stable-base control.
debug.acceptance: Retargeting prevents a coherent verified observation. The stable receipt identifies the exact base and head.

checkpoints.title: Validate smoke mode and matcher types before execution

debug.reproduce: Exercise argv-only, URL-only, both, neither and a non-string contains matcher with a harmless action marker.
debug.acceptance: Valid modes still work. Invalid specs stop before requests or command execution, with a structured diagnostic.

checkpoints.title: Make Graphify binary inventory size behavior explicit

debug.reproduce: Run valid inventory below and above the 1 MB cap, plus a text anchor boundary control.
debug.acceptance: The published limits match observed behavior. Any larger inventory support remains bounded and preserves exact source digests.

checkpoints.title: Isolate smoke commands from the audited Git repository

debug.reproduce: Have a disposable action write a harmless local Git setting. Inspect the source configuration, refs and files afterward.
debug.acceptance: The audited repository remains unchanged under the default smoke behavior. Ordinary output and exit checks still work.

checkpoints.title: Include audit scope in adopter receipts

debug.reproduce: Compare the same commit across distinct repository labels, profiles and subprojects.
debug.acceptance: The receipt makes the selected scope distinguishable and states which repository identity was inferred or verified.

checkpoints.title: Distinguish GitHub run attempts and jobs in receipts

debug.reproduce: Use two attempts with one run ID, distinct jobs, and a standalone execution.
debug.acceptance: Hosted receipts identify the actual attempt and job. Standalone output stays usable and labels unavailable CI metadata.

checkpoints.title: Make partial-clone object fetching explicit

debug.reproduce: Use a missing blob with the offline policy and an explicitly permitted fetch, plus a complete-clone control.
debug.acceptance: Offline reads leave the blob unfetched and report the gap. Authorized fetches and complete clones record the actual coverage.

checkpoints.title: Reject empty or separately label empty Graphify output

debug.reproduce: Build zero-evidence, inventory-only and feature-bearing manifests.
debug.acceptance: A root-only graph cannot qualify as evidence-bearing. Supported inventory and feature controls retain accurate MCP evidence and receipts.

checkpoints.title: Validate the SVG element namespace

debug.reproduce: Use valid default and prefixed SVG namespaces, a foreign namespace and malformed XML.
debug.acceptance: Only supported SVG root identities pass. Wrong namespace and malformed XML retain meaningful diagnostics.

checkpoints.title: Parse GitHub plain-mode query parameters

debug.reproduce: Compare plain mode alone, extra parameters in either order, and an invalid line range.
debug.acceptance: Valid plain links remain valid with extra query parameters. An invalid range still fails the line bounds check.

checkpoints.title: Require rendered checkpoint and version tables

debug.reproduce: Fence the approved-looking plan and version rows, then add table-looking examples beside a real rendered table.
debug.acceptance: Hidden tables fail the appropriate reader or Graphify checks. Only the actual navigation table is counted.

checkpoints.title: Reuse public GitHub metadata within one learning intake

debug.reproduce: Replay 32 distinct anchors at one commit with a bounded mock API budget, then vary the commit and simulate a genuine limit.
debug.acceptance: Redundant metadata calls collapse while each anchor is independently checked. Distinct commits and rate-limit diagnostics remain accurate.

checkpoints.title: Distinguish raw GitHub files from rendered heading destinations

debug.reproduce: Compare a raw URL and a rendered blob URI for the same tracked Markdown and fragment.
debug.acceptance: The raw file’s existence is tracked separately from unsupported fragment coverage. The real rendered heading still verifies.

checkpoints.title: Prevent draft reads through symlinked ancestors

debug.reproduce: Replace a tracked directory with an internal symlink, then test an external target and a normal edited draft.
debug.acceptance: Substituted bytes are rejected or explicitly marked outside tracked draft coverage. A regular draft still validates normally.

checkpoints.title: Keep validation errors visible when receipt writes fail

debug.reproduce: Use an existing directory as the receipt path for a broken-link audit and a passing audit.
debug.acceptance: The persistence issue is reported without dropping findings or emitting a traceback. A writable receipt path still produces valid JSON.

checkpoints.title: Detect missing HTML image alternatives

debug.reproduce: Compare omitted alt, an explicitly decorative empty alt, and descriptive alt.
debug.acceptance: Omission receives a meaningful diagnostic. Both valid accessibility controls retain their expected result.

checkpoints.title: Apply or reject adopter-only flags explicitly

debug.reproduce: Run standalone defaults, adopter scope flags without a repository, and valid and invalid explicit adopter scopes.
debug.acceptance: The CLI never silently validates README HQ when the user supplied a different scope. Valid standalone and adopter uses remain supported.

checkpoints.title: Validate the learning request structure before processing

debug.reproduce: Use an array, null, malformed nested source and target data, and a valid object.
debug.acceptance: Malformed inputs receive stable CLI diagnostics without a traceback or receipt publication. Valid intake still writes its receipt.

checkpoints.title: Verify Graphify inventory relations over MCP

debug.reproduce: Use a count-preserving mutation of an inventory edge and the matching graph digest, with valid inventory and feature controls.
debug.acceptance: Wrong inventory identities or destinations fail the real MCP readback. Correct feature and file relations still pass.

checkpoints.title: Make Windows CI fail on the validator’s actual exit

debug.reproduce: Force the validator to fail before a passing test command, then repeat with both commands passing.
debug.acceptance: The public Windows job comes back red for validator failure and preserves its receipt. Ubuntu and clean Windows controls pass.

checkpoints.title: Recognize the repository’s actual Quickstart

debug.reproduce: Audit the candidate README, a valid action after a large navigation table, and a fake Quickstart with an unrelated link.
debug.acceptance: The real first action passes. The invalid route fails and the validator still identifies the effective README.

checkpoints.title: Make rich-text navigation coverage explicit

debug.reproduce: Use pinned reStructuredText and AsciiDoc files with good and broken links, anchors and first actions.
debug.acceptance: Supported routes are checked and bad ones diagnosed. Unsupported coverage is explicit and cannot look like complete validation.

checkpoints.title: Publish a copyable first-action proof guide

debug.reproduce: Run documented command-mode examples from clean Ubuntu and Windows checkouts, then exercise the documented failure and URL behavior.
debug.acceptance: The example binds the expected result to an exact SHA and working directory and yields inspectable pass and failure receipts.

checkpoints.title: Reuse parsed anchors for a pinned Markdown blob

debug.reproduce: Measure actual reads and parses for 64 links to one file, then include distinct refs and fragments and an edited draft.
debug.acceptance: Redundant blob work falls while valid and broken links keep their exact outcomes. An updated draft cannot reuse stale anchors.

checkpoints.title: Prepare reader dependencies before the retained plan check

debug.reproduce: Run the intended plan workflow against a clean interpreter and the pinned checkout without preinstalled packages.
debug.acceptance: The hashed reader setup precedes validation, or the historical workflow runs against its declared original checkout. Reader and Graphify steps run in the intended order.

checkpoints.title: Link Graphify rich-text evidence to physical source lines

debug.reproduce: Generate Markdown, reStructuredText and AsciiDoc line links and open the pinned examples.
debug.acceptance: Each supported link resolves to the exact source view and line. The changed map and receipt pass Graphify MCP verification.

checkpoints.title: Retain real Graphify evidence after a failed CI attempt

debug.reproduce: Force a verification mismatch after an earlier artifact was produced. Repeat on a successful run.
debug.acceptance: The failed job stays failed, and its attempt-specific diagnostic and available evidence remain downloadable. Prior and unchecked receipts are labeled separately.

checkpoints.title: Publish plan partitions only after all staged manifests succeed

debug.reproduce: Make a second partition fail in a 33-checkpoint plan, then correct it and retry at the same output path.
debug.acceptance: The failed input leaves no partial published manifests. The corrected retry succeeds at the original destination and preserves complete partition coverage.

checkpoints.title: Make required first-action verification distinguish skipped coverage

debug.reproduce: Request a pinned HTTPS probe without network permission. Compare blocked, unresolved and failing probes with a successful local action.
debug.acceptance: A skipped or blocked required smoke check cannot look like a confirmed pass. Network access remains opt-in and the observed result is explicit.

checkpoints.title: Preserve actionable first-action failure diagnostics

debug.reproduce: Run commands with the same exit code and distinct failure reasons, then exercise an output-marker mismatch and a missing file.
debug.acceptance: The receipt distinguishes failure causes, retains reproducibility hashes and exposes bounded diagnostics under the documented redaction policy.

checkpoints.title: Distinguish retryable GitHub errors from invalid learning evidence

debug.reproduce: Simulate HTTP 429 and a wrong pinned source anchor, then run the valid control.
debug.acceptance: The CLI reports distinct structured error categories and retry timing when provided, with sanitized context. Valid intake still succeeds.
